name: The Deep Dark and the Warden

pages.text: Deeper and Darker and DnT Ancient City Overhaul rebuild the Ancient Cities around Y -52.

Kill the $(bold)Warden$() (6,000 HP) for the $(bold)Heart of the Deep$(). Clear the sculk off the big archway in the middle of an Ancient City and right-click the frame with the Heart. That is the portal to the Otherside.
